text:
rachel: Quick pattern note from the end-of-quarter sweep. There's a recurring signature: KV-cache growth on long-lived sessions -> gradual memory pressure -> model OOM and restart. I pulled 7 incidents across Feb/Mar that look similar. Thoughts?

ben: Seen that. Mostly on Dedicated pools with multi-tenant long-running chats. Cache retention config was default and some tenants never purge.

mina: Do we know if runtime_version correlates? I remember an older build kept larger per-token caches.

eli: Checked two incidents: both on runtime v2.1.0. Later builds v2.3.4 seemed better but not universally rolled out.

rachel: Proposed actions: 1) short-term: add a per-tenant max-kv-entries cap + eviction policy (owner: ben) ETA 2026-04-10; 2) medium-term: runtime upgrade rollout to v2.3.4 with memory-improv flags (owner: mina) ETA 2026-04-25; 3) infra alert: "kv-cache-growth" when memory_rss increases >25% in 15m and cache_entries > threshold (owner: ops) ETA 2026-04-05.

ben: I'll take the per-tenant cap experiment. Will add a config flag and test in staging.

mina: I can schedule the staged runtime rollout. Need to coordinate with infra for canary ring.

ops-bot: Auto-note: incident 1834020001 had memory_rss growth of +38% over 12m; cache_entries peaked at 1.2M. Recommend alert thresholds: rss_increase>20% AND cache_entries>500k.

rachel: Also adding an action to backfill PMR rows for affected incidents and mark owners. Owner: rachel. ETA 2026-04-03.

eli: Can we add a small success metric? e.g., reduce memory-related restarts by 80% for tenants with cap enabled within 30 days.

ben: +1. I'll include expected perf delta and rollback plan.

mina: For rollout, will include runtime_version split and monitor p95 latency and memory restarts.

rachel: Action recap (react with :thumbsup: to accept): - ben: per-tenant kv cap + staging test (ETA 2026-04-10) - mina: runtime upgrade canary + rollout plan (ETA 2026-04-25) - ops: create kv-cache-growth alert and canary monitor (ETA 2026-04-05) - rachel: PMR backfill + owner assignment (ETA 2026-04-03)

ben: +1

mina: +1

ops-bot: Reminder set: follow-up sync on 2026-04-12 11:00 PT.

eli: I'll add dashboard panels for cache_entries and rss_growth.

rachel: Thanks everyone  please link PRs/tickets in the tracker so the monthly patterns digest can include remediation coverage.

ops-bot: Thread archived to incident-patterns index."
